name: Charged Stormwater
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). Effects:
• Damage 1.75 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Soaked for 8.8 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 5 blocks, 1.75 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
self_description:
